name: MEDIAIPLUS
summary: Clinical-trial intelligence platform providing global clinical trial data, customized analytics, and sponsor-CRO matching.
content:
Company Overview # MEDIAIPLUS is a healthcare data company that builds a clinical trial intelligence platform. The company addresses the inefficiencies in clinical trial preparation and the difficulty of finding the right contract research organization (CRO). By aggregating and processing global clinical trial data, MEDIAIPLUS provides actionable insights to biotech firms, CROs, researchers, and patients.
Technology & Product # The core product is MediC, a global clinical trial information service. MediC allows users to search clinical trial data, organize information, and track the latest regulations and trial designs. MEDIAIPLUS also operates FiCRO, a sponsor-CRO matching service that connects drug developers with suitable CROs, offering automated matching, notifications, and digital RFP management.
Market & Use Cases # The primary market consists of early-stage pharmaceutical and biotech companies preparing for clinical trials. These companies use MediC to obtain customized reports on drug patents, clinical trial designs, and regulatory insights. The FiCRO service targets sponsors who need to efficiently select and manage CROs for their clinical trials.
Traction & References # MediC provides a database built on over 700,000 processed and annotated clinical trial records globally. As of February 2026, FiCRO has secured a database of more than 29,700 CROs worldwide(Hankyung). The company reports that the platform cuts clients’ clinical preparation time from roughly six months to about ten days, with significant cost savings. The company holds CDISC Platinum certification and participated in the NEMIC healthtech accelerator program in the US in 2023. MEDIAIPLUS was also selected for the TIPS program and the IBK Changgong innovation program, and won an excellence award from the Korea Data Agency (K-DATA).
Collaboration Relevance # MEDIAIPLUS is relevant for biotech companies seeking data-driven insights for clinical trial design and efficient CRO selection. It is also suitable for global CROs looking to connect with Korean drug developers. Pharmaceutical companies can leverage the MediC platform for regulatory insights and competitive intelligence during the early stages of drug development.

name: MEDIHUB
summary: Digitally controlled automatic injector platform designed to reduce injection pain and improve clinician convenience through precise automatic dosing.
content:
Company Overview # MEDIHUB is a medical device company developing the i-JECT lineup of digitally controlled automatic injectors. The company aims to shift the injection paradigm by ensuring patients experience less pain and clinicians enjoy greater convenience. Using precision dosing and pain-reduction algorithms, MEDIHUB is expanding its footprint across the dental, medical, and aesthetic markets.
Technology & Product # The core offering is the i-JECT product family, which includes i-JECT ST for local anesthesia, i-JECT B, i-JECT V, and i-JECT MD. These devices use a pain-relief algorithm and provide precise, automated volume control and constant pressure injection. The i-JECT ST was developed through collaborative research with the Seoul National University Dental Hospital Medical Device R&BD platform. The i-JECT B is specifically designed to reduce procedure pain and minimize drug loss using a patented Low Dead Space syringe.
Market & Use Cases # MEDIHUB’s injectors target healthcare professionals in dentistry, general medicine, and medical aesthetics who perform frequent local anesthesia or precise drug injections. The devices improve the patient experience by minimizing pain and alleviate the physical strain on clinicians by automating the injection pressure and volume.
Traction & References # The company has successfully commercialized its i-JECT ST, B, V, and MD product lines. In April 2026, MEDIHUB secured a distribution agreement with L&C Bio for the i-JECT B in domestic and select overseas markets, pairing the injector with L&C Bio’s ECM-based regenerative solution(Seoul Economic Daily). MEDIHUB holds necessary medical device sales and manufacturing licenses and was selected for the TIPS program in 2018.
Collaboration Relevance # MEDIHUB is well-positioned for distribution and commercial partnerships with medical supply distributors, particularly in the aesthetic and dental sectors. The technology is relevant for pharmaceutical and regenerative medicine companies seeking delivery hardware to enhance the application and reduce the waste of high-value therapeutics.

name: MEDIIMG
summary: FDA- and MFDS-approved 3D Color MRA software that converts 2D black-and-white TOF-MRA into color cerebrovascular hemodynamic biomarker data.
content:
Company Overview # MEDIIMG is a medical imaging AI company specializing in cerebrovascular disease diagnostics. The company develops solutions that convert conventional 2D black-and-white TOF-MRA images into 3D color visualizations and quantitative hemodynamic data. By providing clear cerebrovascular biomarkers, MEDIIMG assists clinicians in assessing blood vessel health and analyzing risk factors.
Technology & Product # The core product is NeuFlow, an FDA-approved 3D Color MRA software and the first MRA-based software to analyze cerebrovascular wall shear stress. NeuFlow processes standard TOF-MRA scans to extract 3D color images and quantitative wall shear stress data, expressed as a Shear-induced Gray (SIG) biomarker, without requiring complex clinical setups or advanced imaging hardware. It generates comprehensive AI Health Reports that offer precise vessel-specific measurements, aiding in clinical decision-making for cerebrovascular conditions.
Market & Use Cases # NeuFlow targets hospitals and diagnostic imaging centers dealing with neurological and cerebrovascular health. It is used by radiologists and neurologists to predict and monitor the risk of conditions such as cerebral aneurysms. The software integrates seamlessly into existing workflows, allowing rapid measurements and quantitative data extraction from standard MRA scans.
Traction & References # NeuFlow received FDA 510(k) clearance in October 2024 and is also approved by the MFDS in Korea. MEDIIMG has established a robust clinical research network, collaborating with major institutions including Seoul National University Hospital, Samsung Medical Center, Ajou University Hospital, and Jeonbuk National University Hospital. The company was selected for the TIPS program in 2024.
Collaboration Relevance # MEDIIMG is highly relevant for medical imaging platforms and PACS providers looking to integrate advanced neurovascular AI capabilities. It also presents a strong partnership opportunity for global healthcare equipment manufacturers and neurology-focused clinical research institutions seeking validated cerebrovascular biomarkers.

name: Meta Physical Intelligence
summary: Meta Physical Intelligence develops AI-based technologies for early detection of electrical anomalies in electrified mobility, focusing on EV battery safety, predictive maintenance, and prevention of critical battery failures.
content:
Company Overview # Meta Physical Intelligence develops AI-based technologies for early detection of electrical anomalies in electrified mobility, focusing on EV battery safety, predictive maintenance, and prevention of critical battery failures.
Technology & Product # Its ELI Solution combines ultra-high-speed signal sampling, data processing, and multimodal AI to identify electrical abnormalities that conventional BMS or ECU monitoring may not detect at an early stage.
The solution consists of three components: ELI Care, hardware capable of 20 ns sampling and 50 million samples per second; ELI Connected, a preprocessing SaaS platform; and ELI AI, which applies AI models to predict abnormal battery and power-system behavior. Target anomalies include voltage imbalance, insulation degradation, internal short circuits, and arcing.
Market & Use Cases # The technology can be applied to EV battery safety, predictive maintenance, vehicle diagnostics, fleet monitoring, and electrified mobility systems. By identifying precursors to serious battery failures, the solution is designed to support earlier intervention and risk management.
Traction & References # Meta Physical Intelligence’s technology has achieved approximately 99% prediction accuracy and has been validated through real-world applications. Beyond automotive applications, the company has also secured a predictive-maintenance contract in the rail sector. Its technology has received recognition including awards at CES 2026 and the Edison Awards 2026. Technology maturity is assessed at approximately TRL 7.
Collaboration Relevance # Potential collaboration with Mercedes-Benz includes integrating Meta Physical Intelligence’s early-warning sensing and AI analytics into EV battery diagnostics. The technology could support battery safety monitoring, predictive maintenance, and future customer-facing diagnostic services.

name: Microt Inc.
summary: Minimally invasive glaucoma surgery implant designed to help regulate intraocular pressure through aqueous humor drainage.
content:
Company Overview # Microt Inc. is a medical device company specializing in ophthalmic treatments. The company focuses on developing safe and reliable therapeutic alternatives for glaucoma, a leading cause of blindness worldwide. By designing precision implants, Microt aims to improve patient outcomes through minimally invasive intraocular pressure regulation.
Technology & Product # The flagship product is the A-stream Glaucoma Shunt, a minimally invasive glaucoma surgery (MIGS) implant. Manufactured domestically in Korea, the A-stream is a 6mm ultra-small tube made of medical-grade silicone. It features a 100μm inner diameter and a 1mm wing fixation structure. The device works by creating a new drainage pathway for aqueous humor, safely reducing intraocular pressure. Microt has also expanded its portfolio into related eye care spaces, launching the Cleaneol eyelid cleanser and Maxnamin health supplements.
Market & Use Cases # A-stream targets ophthalmologists and eye clinics performing glaucoma surgeries. As a MIGS/MIBS device, it provides an effective surgical option for patients who do not respond adequately to eye drop medications, offering a safer profile compared to traditional, highly invasive glaucoma drainage surgeries.
Traction & References # A-stream has demonstrated solid clinical validity and commercial traction. By February 2026, the implant had surpassed 3,000 cumulative sales in Korea and was adopted by over 100 domestic medical institutions(Hankyung). A retrospective study published in Eye (2025) analyzing 49 eyes implanted with A-stream reported a significant reduction in mean intraocular pressure from 26.9±8.3 mmHg to 11.9±3.5 mmHg at six months(PMC). Microt holds necessary medical device manufacturing and sales licenses and collaborates on R&D with institutions such as KAIST, Sungkyunkwan University, and Chungbuk National University.
Collaboration Relevance # Microt is a strong candidate for commercial distribution partnerships with global ophthalmic device companies looking to expand their MIGS portfolios. It is also well-suited for joint clinical trials and R&D collaborations with international eye centers aiming to validate the efficacy of new glaucoma implants in diverse demographics.

name: MK Solar
summary: MK Solar supplies wood pellet and biomass renewable fuel to power plants and recovers rare earth metals from end-of-life permanent magnets.
content:
Company Overview # MK Solar is an eco-friendly energy and resource-circulation company whose core business is supplying renewable fuel. Its main operation is supplying wood pellet and biomass renewable fuel to domestic power plants, alongside a resource-circulation (ESG) business that recovers rare earth metals from end-of-life permanent magnets and industrial waste.
The company started by exporting solar materials such as polysilicon, then expanded into renewable power-plant fuel supply and international freight forwarding. More recently it has grown rare earth recycling as a new ESG growth area.
Technology & Product # Renewable fuel supply (core): Steady supply of wood pellet and biomass renewable fuel to domestic power plants. Rare earth and valuable-metal recovery (ESG): Extracts and regenerates rare earth components from waste magnets and electronic scrap using eco-friendly leaching and high-purity separation, restoring purity and performance close to new magnet material. Ytterbium (Yb) recycling for display: Recovers ytterbium (Yb) from OLED deposition scrap and refines it to 3N5 (99.987%) purity using a patented wet/dry hybrid process (KR 10-2652842, 10-2651225). The recycled Yb has passed technical verification by a top-tier global display manufacturer. Waste acid and solvent purification: Cleans waste phosphoric acid, processing oils, and used solvents so they can be reused, cutting both waste-treatment and raw-material costs. Market & Use Cases # Core customers are power generators and energy buyers that need renewable fuel, along with magnet, motor, electronics, and semiconductor manufacturers that generate rare earth scrap or chemical waste. These customers face both high prices for imported rare earth inputs and waste-disposal costs.

name: MOBILWITHUS
summary: Automotive embedded security software company for ECU, SDV, ESS BMS, and cybersecurity compliance.
content:
Company Overview # MOBILWITHUS develops embedded security software for vehicles and connected control systems. The company focuses on ECU software, SDV security, automotive semiconductor security, and regulatory cybersecurity needs.
Its work is relevant as vehicles, batteries, and industrial equipment become more software-defined. OEMs and Tier suppliers need secure boot, secure updates, key management, diagnostics, and compliance evidence across many controllers.
Technology & Product # MOBIL Sherpa+ is an automotive embedded security complex device driver. It helps OEMs and Tier suppliers integrate HSM and HSE functions into ECUs.
The product supports AUTOSAR CDD, AUTOSAR and non-AUTOSAR interfaces, MCAL, and hardware abstraction. It covers Secure Boot, Secure Communication, Secure Access, Secure Authentication, Secure Storage, Secure Debug, Secure Software Update, and Secure Key Management.
MOBILWITHUS also provides engineering, test, and consulting services for security requirements, UDS diagnostics, FBL, AUTOSAR application CDD, legacy software, and secure coding review.
Market & Use Cases # The main users are automotive OEMs, Tier suppliers, semiconductor teams, ESS BMS makers, and heavy-equipment manufacturers. The product is useful where software controllers must meet cybersecurity regulations and buyer security requirements.
Use cases include UN ECE R155 and R156 response, Cyber Resilience Act preparation, secure ECU integration, controller-level security tests, and production software validation.
Traction & References # MOBIL Sherpa+ has been validated across more than four global OEM programs and more than eleven ECU projects.
The supported semiconductor lineup includes NXP S32K1XX/S32K3XX, Infineon TC3XX, and Microchip SAME5X/SAMC2X/TA100. MOBILWITHUS also applied and supplied CRA security functions for an ESS BMS project in 2026.
The company has joined IBK Changgong programs, including Germany and Luxembourg-linked scale-up tracks.
Collaboration Relevance # MOBILWITHUS can work with OEMs, Tier suppliers, semiconductor companies, ESS makers, and industrial equipment companies. A practical PoC can test secure boot, secure update, key management, or cybersecurity compliance evidence on a defined controller.
For Korea-Europe collaboration, the company is relevant to European automotive cybersecurity rules, CRA response, and supplier-level software security validation.

name: momogo
summary: Online retailer bringing authentic Korean and Asian groceries to customers in Germany and Europe.
content:
Company Overview # momogo is an online store for authentic Korean and Asian groceries in Germany and Europe. It was founded in Berlin in 2019 by Korean and Taiwanese founders who wanted to make Asian home cooking easy for European customers. The company started as EasyCookAsia with a small range of cooking boxes and later rebranded to momogo as a full Asian grocery retailer. Today it sells snacks, ramen, drinks, ingredients, and cooking kits sourced from Korea, Japan, Taiwan, China, Thailand, Vietnam, and India.
Technology & Product # momogo runs a direct-to-consumer e-commerce platform with a curated Asian food catalog and a Korea-focused product line. The original product is the ready-to-cook cooking box, which pairs the ingredients and a recipe for a specific dish in one set. Around this, the shop is organized into clear categories such as Korean BBQ, ramyeon, tteokbokki, drinks, and snacks, with country guides that help customers pick products they cannot easily find locally. A “momogo Club” loyalty program adds points, referrals, and member deals. The company ships across Germany and Europe with free shipping over €49.99 and 2-4 day delivery.
Market & Use Cases # The main customers are consumers in Germany and Europe who want authentic Asian food but struggle to find the right ingredients or trustworthy recipes. This includes the growing audience following Korean food, K-pop, and Korean convenience-store snacks. The catalog serves both everyday grocery shopping and gift buying, with dedicated gift sets and gift cards. A separate wholesale channel supplies restaurants, retailers, and other business buyers.
Traction & References # momogo has grown from about 100 orders and 10 products at launch to more than 60,000 orders and over 2,000 products(about). It began at Startup Incubator Berlin under the Berlin Startup Scholarship(Startup Incubator Berlin). It was ranked #3 in the cooking box category as Best Online Portal in 2023, 2024, and 2025, and won a Best Online Shop Consumer Choice award in Germany in 2023(about). Its investors include Korea Innovation Center Europe (KIC Europe) and Strong Ventures. It runs a wholesale B2B channel alongside its consumer store.
Collaboration Relevance # momogo is a useful partner for Korean and Asian food brands that want to reach German and European consumers through an established online channel and curated marketing. It fits distribution and market-entry deals, private-label or co-branded products, and promotion tied to Korean food and culture trends. Its wholesale channel opens B2B supply to restaurants and retailers, and its Berlin base makes it a practical bridge for Korea-Europe food commerce.

name: Nanobridge
summary: Nanobridge produces nano-carbon materials and makes CRYOLINK, a nano-carbon liquid coolant for AI data centers and other high-heat systems.
content:
Company Overview # Nanobridge is a Korean materials company that produces nano-carbon materials such as graphene and carbon nanotubes (CNT). It covers the full chain from raw material to composite development, and it also builds finished application products.
Its flagship product is CRYOLINK, a nano-carbon liquid coolant for AI data centers. The company also develops NVIA, a flame-retardant film and coating material. Nanobridge started in 2023. Its headquarters is in Gwanak-gu, Seoul, and its R&D center is in Bupyeong-gu, Incheon.
Technology & Product # CRYOLINK is a liquid coolant enhanced with nano-carbon for fast heat dissipation and high thermal efficiency. The company reports a cooling-rate improvement above 20%, an operating range of about -20°C to 105°C, Grade 1 corrosion protection, and low viscosity near 13 cP. CRYOLINK uses carbon-based materials instead of metal nanoparticles, which avoids the oxidation problems common with metal-based coolants.
Two in-house capabilities support the product. First, Nanobridge produces its own nano-carbon materials with a proprietary graphene process that combines physical and physicochemical steps, which lowers reliance on costly commercial inputs. Second, a surface-modification dispersion technology keeps the nano-carbon stable in the fluid for more effective heat transfer.
NVIA is a separate flame-retardant material line. A transparent type targets display and building fire protection, and an opaque type is being developed to help prevent thermal runaway in EV batteries.
Market & Use Cases # AI data centers are the first target market. As compute density rises, cooling moves from air to liquid, and coolant becomes critical infrastructure. Nanobridge sells CRYOLINK to liquid-cooling system providers that serve AI data centers, starting with single-rack pilots and expanding to multi-rack and full data center deployment.
The company plans to expand into automotive and EV thermal management and, later, aerospace. For early adoption, Nanobridge also plans a consumer-accessible channel, selling CRYOLINK online for workstations and small servers to build brand awareness and demand.
Traction & References # In its own engine cooling test, CRYOLINK delivered up to 18% higher heat rejection than conventional coolant under high-load conditions. In a closed-loop CPU cooling test in a custom liquid-cooled PC, it lowered CPU temperature by 6-9°C versus conventional coolant. Sample sales are ongoing, and a product launch for workstations and small servers is planned.
Nanobridge exhibited CRYOLINK and NVIA at JEC World 2026 in Paris (March 10-12), in the Korean pavilion organized by Korean carbon-industry bodies(Industry Ilbo). In its first year the company recorded early sales and was supported through the 2023 Pre-startup Package via Seoul National University and the IP Nare program(Hankyung Job&Joy).
Collaboration Relevance # Nanobridge fits liquid-cooling system providers, AI data center operators, and automotive or EV partners that need higher thermal performance. The clearest entry point is a single-rack CRYOLINK proof of concept with a cooling system provider, which can scale to larger deployments as volume grows.
For Korea-Europe collaboration, the JEC World Paris exhibition shows active interest in European markets. CRYOLINK is relevant for European data center cooling partners, and the NVIA line could suit EV battery safety and building fire-protection projects.

name: NAVOROS
summary: NAVOROS builds integrated safety infrastructure for commercial drone fleets, combining AI risk detection, airbag and parachute mitigation, an independent incident recorder, and fleet data for insurance review.
content:
Company Overview # NAVOROS builds integrated safety systems for commercial drone (UAV) fleets. The platform connects four parts: risk detection, physical crash mitigation, independent incident recording, and fleet data for insurance review. The goal is to make commercial drone risk measurable and to reduce losses from crashes and third-party damage.
The company sells to drone manufacturers, operators, and public agencies, with both B2B and B2G models. NAVOROS started in 2023 and was incorporated as NAVOROS Co., Ltd. in 2025. It is based in Gumi, Gyeongsangbuk-do.
Technology & Product # NAVOROS combines four products into one safety platform. NAVOROS Core is an independent safety controller and flight-data recorder. It uses its own sensors, such as IMU, air pressure, temperature, GNSS, and voltage or current, together with on-device AI to detect abnormal flight and assess risk. It records before and after an event, keeps its own power and storage, and transmits encrypted data over LTE. Because it works independently of the flight controller (FC/MC), its records can survive a crash, water, or fire.
Protect is a skid-type airbag that deploys automatically to absorb impact and to give temporary buoyancy after a water landing. Recover is a parachute system that slows descent after a confirmed fall. Together they reduce impact to people, the aircraft, and the payload.
NAVOROS Fleet is a safety dashboard. It turns flight records into fleet readiness, safety scores, and claims evidence. An embedded low-power beacon also transmits incident location and status.
Market & Use Cases # Commercial drone use is growing in industrial inspection, logistics, public-sector, and emergency-response work. As fleets grow, the risk of crashes and third-party losses grows too. Today, flight data, incident records, and safety-device data often sit apart from insurance decisions.
NAVOROS targets operators and agencies that need to prove what happened in an incident and lower their risk exposure. Typical cases include a crash investigation that needs trustworthy flight evidence, a fleet operator that wants safety scores, and an insurer that needs reliable data for underwriting, renewal, and claims.
Traction & References # NAVOROS showed its integrated safety system at the 9th Defense Science and Technology Fair at the aT Center in Seoul, held from 30 July to 1 August 2026(Industry Ilbo). The company plans proof-of-concept tests with the Korea Transportation Safety Authority and LIG, and plans to exhibit at CES 2027(Industry Ilbo).
Drop testing under controlled conditions showed up to 71% lower impact transmitted to the aircraft and payload, up to 93% lower impact to the ground, and successful flotation after airbag deployment. Results depend on the aircraft, drop height, and surface. These tests do not yet demonstrate lower insurance losses, and the product is at the prototype stage.
Collaboration Relevance # NAVOROS fits drone manufacturers, fleet operators, public agencies, and insurers. For manufacturers, the Core recorder and safety devices can be built into new aircraft. For operators, the Fleet dashboard supports maintenance and safety management. For insurers, connected incident and fleet data can support underwriting, renewal, and claims review.
The company proposes a pilot with ERGO ScaleHub to test whether its safety and incident data can improve drone risk decisions in a German use case. This makes NAVOROS relevant for Korea-Europe work on drone safety, insurance data, and fleet risk management. The near-term aim is to validate insurance relevance, not to promise premium reductions.

name: Nine to Six
summary: Functional walking-shoe brand Walking Master, pairing wide-fit comfort shoes and silicone cushioning insoles with a foot-scan matching service.
content:
Company Overview # Nine to Six is a Korean footwear company that runs the walking-shoe brand Walking Master. It designs functional walking shoes and silicone cushioning insoles for comfort and foot health. The shoes are made wider at the toe to fit Asian feet and are developed together with foot doctors. The company also runs a foot-scan service that measures a customer’s feet in about 10 seconds and matches them to the right shoes and insoles.
Technology & Product # The flagship product is the Moolkung walking shoe, paired with a silicone insole that cushions impact. The brand’s edge is comfort: a wide toe-box shaped for Asian feet and a soft, squishy “Moolkung” sole feel. Walking Master’s foot-scan service reads up to 24 foot-data points in about 10 seconds and recommends matching footwear and insoles. Over time the company has built a large dataset of foot shapes that it uses to improve fit and product design.
Market & Use Cases # The brand targets everyday consumers who want comfortable walking shoes, including people with foot pain such as plantar fasciitis. It sells directly through its own Korean and English online stores, and through major Korean retailers and department stores. Nationwide pop-up stores with foot scanners bring the fitting service to shoppers in person.
Traction & References # The company turned profitable in 2021 and has collected foot-scan data from more than 400,000 people through nationwide pop-up stores(MoneyToday). Its silicone insole, which the company says absorbs 98.4% of impact, is a registered patent(MoneyToday). Walking Master products are sold through major Korean retailers including Olive Young, Lotte, Hyundai, and Shinsegae, and by 2020 the brand had about 70,000 members and KRW 2.5 billion in cumulative revenue(Platum). It raised a KRW 800 million seed round from Infobank, CNT Tech, and the Korea Credit Guarantee Fund(MoneyToday), was selected for the TIPS program(Platum), and is a graduate of the IBK Changgong Mapo 5th cohort(MoneyToday). It won gold at international invention expos in Silicon Valley, Geneva, and Seoul(Asiae), and a silver award in the consumer product category at the 2025 Edison Awards(MoneyToday). It also signed an O2O platform agreement with the US foot-health company Aetrex(Platum).
Collaboration Relevance # Nine to Six fits retail and distribution partners looking for differentiated comfort footwear, and health and wellness channels focused on foot care. Its foot-scan data and fitting service suit partnerships with foot-health providers and clinics. With an English store and a 2025 selection for a K-sports global accelerator, the company is preparing for overseas expansion, including Europe.

name: NineBioWare
summary: AI-powered ultra-sensitive blood diagnostics for early detection of neurodegenerative diseases.
content:
Company Overview # NineBioWare is an AI diagnostics company focused on the early detection of neurodegenerative diseases. By combining multi-biomarker blood panels with artificial intelligence, the company aims to identify early signs of conditions such as Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and Parkinson’s disease (PD).
Technology & Product # The platform combines the FluometricDX reader, a fluorescence-based biosensing device, with the FluoreArray microfluidic cartridge and machine-learning analysis to run ultra-sensitive blood diagnostics. The company is developing spiral microfluidic detection platforms and biomolecule detection devices that use stretchable materials. These platforms capture and analyze fluid samples via antibody-binding complexes to extract complex biomarker profiles for AI analysis.
Market & Use Cases # NineBioWare’s solutions target clinical laboratories, diagnostic centers, and neurology departments seeking less invasive, blood-based alternatives to traditional neurodegenerative screening methods like cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) taps or expensive PET scans. name: Nota AI
summary: Nota AI optimizes AI models for hardware and runs on-device vision intelligence for edge devices, transport, and safety.
content:
Company Overview # Nota AI is a Korean company that makes AI models smaller and faster so they can run on edge devices. Its core platform, NetsPresso, optimizes models for specific hardware. On top of this, Nota AI builds on-device vision intelligence products for smart cities, transportation, and industrial safety.
The company started in 2015 and is now listed on the KOSDAQ market. It operates from a Daejeon headquarters with additional offices in Seoul, Sunnyvale, and Berlin.
Technology & Product # NetsPresso is an AI model optimization platform that understands hardware characteristics. It covers model development, model optimization, and model validation in one place. The platform uses techniques such as structured pruning, quantization, and graph optimization, then validates results on real devices to reduce trial and error.
Nota Vision Agent turns video into actionable insight using generative AI. It supports real-time monitoring, instant alerts, event summary reports, and natural-language Q&A and video search. The company also offers intelligent transportation systems (ITS) and driver monitoring and face recognition (DMS & FR) solutions for traffic and automotive use.
Market & Use Cases # Nota AI serves two main groups. The first is device makers and chip vendors that need efficient AI on constrained hardware. The second is public-sector and industrial customers that need video intelligence for traffic, safety, and surveillance.
Typical use cases include license plate recognition, pedestrian and fall detection, driver monitoring, and city traffic optimization. The ITS product reuses existing CCTV infrastructure, which lowers deployment cost.
Traction & References # Cumulative patent filings are 215 and registered patents are 108(DIPS1000+). Revenue grew from KRW 8.4 billion in 2024 to KRW 13.1 billion in 2025(Sisa Journal-e).
Nota AI works with global semiconductor companies including NVIDIA, Qualcomm, Samsung Electronics, Renesas, Sony, MediaTek, and NXP(Nota AI). It was selected for CB Insights’ 2025 AI 100 and won a 2024 Minister of SMEs and Startups award(DIPS1000+). In 2025 it signed a supply contract with Dubai’s Roads and Transport Authority for a generative-AI traffic solution(Nota AI ITS). The company is registered on the DIPS1000+ deep-tech list and was a 2017 TIPS startup(DIPS1000+).
Collaboration Relevance # Nota AI fits chipmakers, device OEMs, automotive suppliers, and public agencies. NetsPresso is a strong PoC target when a partner needs to deploy a high-performance model on limited hardware without losing accuracy. Nota Vision Agent and ITS suit cities and operators that want to upgrade existing camera networks with AI.
For Korea-Europe collaboration, the Berlin office and prior work with European partners such as Deutsche Telekom and Arm make Nota AI relevant for edge-AI and smart-mobility projects in Europe.

name: OpticMix
summary: OpticMix develops holographic optical screen film for transparent displays, AR-like signage, and mobility HUDs.
content:
Company Overview # OpticMix develops holographic optical screen technology. The company combines optical film and high-brightness projection to create transparent display experiences.
The technology targets limitations in existing transparent displays, including brightness, viewing angle, contrast, and installation cost. It can be applied to signage, mobility HUDs, smart-city spaces, healthcare, and clean-room interfaces.
Technology & Product # OpticMix uses holographic optical screen film that passes ambient light while reflecting projected images. This creates a transparent screen effect without relying only on transparent OLED hardware.
Its product and service areas include LUXGRAM holographic screen installation, AuraX signage terminals, and vehicle holographic HUD optical screen film. Its technology lowers installation cost compared with transparent OLED while supporting high brightness and high transparency.
Market & Use Cases # OpticMix is relevant for mobility HUD developers, retail signage operators, smart-city projects, hospitals, manufacturing clean rooms, and public-space interfaces.
Use cases include large vehicle HUD screens, transparent advertising displays, touchless spatial interaction, and information screens where visibility and transparency both matter.
Traction & References # OpticMix is part of Kwangwoon University’s 2025 overseas technology commercialization support group. The company is listed as a Seoul Pavilion and faculty startup participant.
The company plans to present vehicle holographic HUD optical screen film at CES 2026 Seoul Pavilion. Korean media also introduced AuraX and LUXGRAM as CES 2026 Seoul Pavilion items.
Collaboration Relevance # OpticMix can work with automotive display teams, HUD suppliers, signage companies, retail-space operators, hospitals, and smart-factory integrators. A practical PoC can test brightness, transparency, viewing distance, and installation constraints in a real display environment.
For Korea-Europe collaboration, the company may fit mobility UX, smart retail, public display infrastructure, and industrial touchless-interface projects.

name: P2ACH AI
summary: P2ACH AI uses on-device vision AI to measure audience engagement for DOOH advertising and retail media.
content:
Company Overview # P2ACH AI turns physical spaces into measurable advertising media using vision AI and edge computing. With a “Zero-Storage” approach, the technology does not store video and instantly converts it into numerical data on the device, blocking privacy-leak risk at the source. This lets advertisers and retailers measure real attention and engagement for out-of-home advertising and in-store media.
Technology & Product # The P2ACH AI platform is built on hybrid measurement that combines Vision AI with WiFi sensing, plus a Dual CAM setup that processes two cameras on a single edge AI box. The Vision AI stack includes camera distortion correction (extrinsic calibration), detection and tracking, and Re-ID, which tracks movement across multiple cameras to count unique visitors without duplicates. Audience analytics estimate visitor age and gender in an anonymized way, and real-time targeting delivers content based on who is actually in front of the screen.
For digital out-of-home (DOOH) media, P2ACH AI combines Vision AI and WiFi sensing to quantify advertising performance with standard metrics such as circulation, OTS, OTC, and VAC. For retail, the platform adds smart shelf and stock analysis, spatial heatmaps of foot traffic, and an AI agent that turns complex data into optimization suggestions.
Market & Use Cases # The main customers are DOOH media owners, retailers, and brands that need proof of advertising performance offline. Typical use cases include measuring ad attention on outdoor screens, analyzing shopper behavior inside stores, preventing out-of-stock situations, and improving merchandising layouts.
Useful pilot settings include retail chains that want shopper-journey data and transit or outdoor media networks that need audience measurement for their screens.
Traction & References # P2ACH AI lists partners and customers including AWS, GS Retail, Hanwha Vision, LOTTE, Shinhan, and Seoul Metro(P2ACH AI). Reported deployment results include higher viewer interest, higher sales for advertised products, and lower operating cost(P2ACH AI). It meets global security standards, including GDPR compliance and ISO certification(P2ACH AI).
In Japan, after proof-of-concept trials, the company signed about KRW 2 billion in solution supply contracts with Shizuoka Railway, Nankai, and local marketing agencies(Money Today). It was selected for the Ministry of SMEs and Startups Scale-up TIPS program(Venture Square) and closed a Pre-Series A round of about KRW 3 billion in 2025(Money Today). It was also selected for the 2026 Gangnam-gu Test-Bed program.
Collaboration Relevance # P2ACH AI can work with retail chains, DOOH and transit media networks, advertising agencies, and digital-signage hardware makers. Its on-device, Zero-Storage design makes it a good fit for markets with strict personal-data rules.
For Korea-Europe collaboration, the company is relevant to retail media measurement, privacy-compliant audience analytics, and edge AI integration into existing screen and signage networks. Its Japan deployments show it can run pilots outside Korea.

name: Perseus
summary: Perseus develops software solutions for Software-Defined Vehicles (SDVs), focusing on virtualization, functional safety, and the consolidation of vehicle computing architectures.
content:
Company Overview # Perseus develops software solutions for Software-Defined Vehicles (SDVs), focusing on virtualization, functional safety, and the consolidation of vehicle computing architectures.
Technology & Product # Its core technology is a multi-domain hypervisor that enables a high-capacity QM-grade operating system, such as Linux or Android, and a safety-grade Safety RTOS to run on a single SoC through secure software partitioning. By replacing multiple dedicated ECUs or boards with a consolidated computing platform, the solution can reduce semiconductor costs, wiring complexity, vehicle weight, and the effort required for functional-safety certification.
Perseus’ hypervisor supports both CPU and MCU architectures and is designed for safety-critical automotive applications.
Market & Use Cases # The technology is designed for next-generation SDV architectures, digital cockpits, domain controllers, and centralized vehicle computing platforms. It can support the consolidation of infotainment and safety-critical functions within a common hardware architecture.
Traction & References # Perseus’ hypervisor has achieved ASIL-D safety certification and is already commercially shipping. The company has technology partnerships with Infineon, NXP, Renesas, and Arm, and has worked with automotive companies including Hyundai, Mando, and LG. Its technology maturity is assessed at approximately TRL 6–7.
Collaboration Relevance # For Mercedes-Benz, potential applications include using Perseus’ hypervisor to consolidate safety-critical software and infotainment functions within MB.OS-based vehicle computing architectures. This could support the development of domain controllers with reduced hardware complexity, cost, and weight.

name: POEN
summary: Circular economy startup transforming used EV battery packs into new energy storage solutions.
content:
Company Overview # POEN remanufactures and recycles electric vehicle (EV) batteries. Spun off from a Hyundai Motor in-house venture, the company assesses the health of end-of-life or damaged EV battery packs. It then rebuilds them into refurbished automotive batteries or repurposes them for stationary Energy Storage Systems (ESS).
Technology & Product # POEN provides a range of battery diagnostics and remanufacturing services:
Battery Remanufacturing: Selects reusable cells and modules from collected batteries and rebuilds them into EV battery packs that pass automotive-grade quality testing. Battery Diagnostics & Residual-Value Assessment: Applies diagnostic algorithms that precisely analyze remaining life, cell-to-cell voltage uniformity, and defects. Second-Life Battery Reuse: Redesigns battery packs that are difficult to remanufacture for vehicles into power sources for other uses such as residential, commercial, and micro-grid ESS and UPS. Market & Use Cases # POEN works with automotive OEMs, battery manufacturers, and fleet operators who must manage battery lifecycles and meet environmental regulations. By remanufacturing battery packs, POEN helps manufacturers and car owners avoid the high cost of brand-new replacements.
Traction & References # POEN has remanufactured more than 1,000 EV battery packs across about ten vehicle models over a four-year period in Korea(THE ELEC). The company maintains active R&D and quality analysis collaborations with major industry players, including SK On, CATL, Webasto, and Hyundai Mobis(POEN). POEN is expanding internationally, having registered a U.S. branch in Los Angeles and a German branch in Frankfurt, and is preparing to set up a battery remanufacturing plant in Europe(THE ELEC). Collaboration Relevance # European automotive OEMs, EV fleet operators, and transit networks can partner with POEN to run local battery remanufacturing, repair, and circular lifecycle programs. Utility firms, charging station operators, and commercial buildings can deploy cost-efficient second-life ESS units. Battery cell manufacturers and Tier 1 suppliers can use POEN’s diagnostic services to analyze pack-level defects and improve battery R&D.

name: Quantum Hi-Tech
summary: Quantum Hi-Tech develops data-driven solutions for EV battery health assessment, helping vehicle owners, fleets, and automotive service providers understand battery condition and degradation using real-world driving data.
content:
Company Overview # Quantum Hi-Tech develops data-driven solutions for EV battery health assessment, helping vehicle owners, fleets, and automotive service providers understand battery condition and degradation using real-world driving data.
Technology & Product # Its TRIZ-AI platform analyzes real-driving BMS data to assess battery State of Health (SOH), degradation patterns, driving characteristics, and abnormal behavior without removing or disassembling the battery.
The platform provides a Battery Health Dashboard and vehicle-specific AI Battery Health Reports, translating battery data into information that can be used for vehicle management, maintenance, and customer-facing services.
Market & Use Cases # Key applications include certified pre-owned EVs, fleet management, after-sales services, vehicle maintenance, battery certification, and EV resale. The technology can improve transparency around battery condition and support more informed decisions across the EV lifecycle.
Traction & References # Quantum Hi-Tech has built a real-world dataset covering more than 1,000 EVs and operates its cloud-based battery analytics service through live pilots. The company received a CES 2026 Innovation Award and is exploring additional applications including insurance, charging services, and battery passports. Technology maturity is assessed at approximately TRL 7–8.
Collaboration Relevance # For Mercedes-Benz, Quantum Hi-Tech could support EV battery health reporting for customers and certified used vehicles, as well as fleet and after-sales services. The solution could provide battery health information based on everyday driving data and help strengthen transparency around EV battery condition and resale value.

name: RightRoute
summary: Recycling technology company turning EV battery separator waste into high-value TEXNIC fabrics and yarns.
content:
Company Overview # RightRoute turns waste materials into higher-value products. Its TEXNIC platform upcycles EV and secondary battery separator waste into textile materials for fashion, interior, and automotive uses.
TEXNIC is a premium recycled material. It uses useful features of battery separator membranes and turns them into functional fabrics and yarns.
Technology & Product # RightRoute works with lithium-ion battery separator waste, including LiBS and ceramic coated separators. These materials are hard to recycle because UHMWPE has very high molecular weight, high viscosity, and difficult molding properties. Much of this waste is usually downcycled, incinerated, or landfilled.
RightRoute’s proprietary processes convert this waste into:
TEXNIC laminated fabric made with lamination, surface processing, and low-temperature bonding. TEXNIC yarn made with separator slitting and winding technology. Functional material lines such as TEXNIC Shell, Pack, Grit, and Nuvo. Market & Use Cases # TEXNIC targets premium recycled textile uses in fashion, interior, and automotive markets.
The material offers moisture permeability, waterproofing, low density, high tensile strength, and durability. It also gives brands a clear recycled-material story.
Traction & References # RightRoute has Pre-A investment and impact investor participation. TEXNIC launched as a premium recycled material in 2023. Fabric commercialization is complete, with production and delivery for multiple companies. Samsung C&T Beanpole launched a 2023 F/W golf line using the material and placed repeat orders. RightRoute has worked on supply or collection relationships with companies including SK IE Technology, W-Scope Korea, UPEX, Hanwha Solutions, SSLM, and LG Chem. Awards and certifications include CES 2022 Wearable Technology Innovation Award, Hyundai Motor Company H-OnDream Startup Ground Excellent Fellow Award, Global Recycle Standard, LCA verification, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, and ISO 9001/14001. Future plans include TEXNIC yarn commercialization, automotive seat market entry, a European factory, and a carbon reduction goal tied to 2030 production volume. Collaboration Relevance # Battery separator makers and recycling partners can use TEXNIC as a higher-value route for separator waste. Fashion, interior, and automotive brands can test TEXNIC for premium recycled material lines. European partners can work with RightRoute on circular materials, automotive interiors, and sustainability-led product development.

name: SHMD
summary: AI-based brain health solutions for stroke prevention, combining a wearable cerebral blood-flow device and a self-screening app.
content:
Company Overview # SHMD develops AI-based brain health solutions for stroke prevention and early detection. The company pairs a wearable cerebral blood-flow device with a self-screening app, so users can check brain health risks without a hospital visit. It also runs an AI Medtech Lab in Seoul.
Technology & Product # SHMD focuses on non-invasive brain health hardware and software:
CEREBAND: A wearable AI device for stroke prevention, built on transcranial Doppler (TCD) sensing to measure and monitor cerebral blood flow. name: SIG Corporation
summary: SIG Corporation builds SENIHUG, a contactless under-mattress AIoT sensor pad that monitors the sleep and vital signs of elderly people for care facilities and local governments.
content:
Company Overview # SIG Corporation is a Korean smart healthcare company focused on senior care. Its main product, SENIHUG, is a contactless sensor pad that monitors the sleep and vital signs of elderly people without any wearable device.
The company serves care facilities, hospitals, and local governments that need to watch over seniors, people living alone, and long-term care residents. The goal is to detect risk situations early and help caregivers respond faster.
Technology & Product # SENIHUG is a sensor pad placed under the mattress. It measures biometric data without a wearable, a charger, or a camera. The pad connects over Wi-Fi and sends data to the server every three seconds, and it reconnects automatically if the connection drops.
The pad captures a single vibration signal that contains chest movement from breathing along with noise. A proprietary algorithm based on Variational Mode Decomposition separates heart rate and respiration from this signal. The AI improves measurement accuracy as it learns, and it derives heart rate variability to help flag signs of depression, anxiety, and stress.
Caregivers view all data in real time through a web dashboard and a mobile app. One screen can monitor many devices at once, and families can also follow a user through the app. When the system detects an anomaly, it sends an alert within about five seconds so staff can act quickly.
Market & Use Cases # The core market is elderly care. Typical customers are nursing homes and care facilities, hospitals, and public agencies that run welfare and safety programs for seniors.
The contactless design fits people who cannot or will not wear a device every day. Common use cases include overnight monitoring of care-facility residents, safety checks for seniors living alone, and loneliness-death prevention programs run by local governments. The same approach also extends to sleep health tracking and early screening for chronic conditions.
Traction & References # SENIHUG was finally selected for the Ministry of SMEs and Startups’ TIPS program, recognized for its AIoT-based contactless biosignal sensing technology(Electronic Times). The company secured about KRW 2.2 billion in commercialization funding in the first half of 2026 through TIPS, the Deep-Tech Startup Academy, the Credit Guarantee Fund’s “Little Penguin” program, admission to SVC Seoul, and a seed bridge investment(Electronic Times).
Its seed round came from the “Hectocorn No. 2” fund, formed by the Hecto Group with accelerator CNT Tech, which backed the company’s contactless biosignal technology and in-house AI algorithm(Electronic Times). The company holds several copyrights and registered patents, and earlier recognitions include an “Excellent” mid-term rating in the 2025 Gyeonggi North Youth Startup Academy, a 2024 Seodaemun-gu youth venture award, and a 2023 “Best” selection in the First-Time Youth Startup program(Electronic Times).
In May 2026 SIG Corporation signed an MOU with iCoop, a digital healthcare platform, to work together on loneliness-death prevention, care monitoring, disease screening, sleep health monitoring, and public and local-government pilots(Electronic Times). The company joined the 2026 Deep-Tech Youth Startup Academy delegation to Düsseldorf, Germany, run by KOSME with 123 Factory as the local partner.
Collaboration Relevance # SIG Corporation suits partners in senior care, digital health, and public welfare. Care facilities, hospitals, insurers, and local governments are natural PoC partners for overnight monitoring and early-warning services. The contactless pad is also a good fit for smart-home, welfare, and remote-patient-monitoring platforms that want vital-sign data without wearables.
For Korea-Europe collaboration, the company’s participation in the Germany delegation opens pre-PoC discovery with European care providers, insurers, and health systems. Europe’s aging population and strong elderly-care sector make SENIHUG relevant for facility monitoring and home-care pilots.

name: SmartRide
summary: SmartRide develops software solutions for commercial fleet management and vehicle operations, with a focus on digitizing maintenance workflows, dispatch operations, and service coordination.
content:
Company Overview # SmartRide develops software solutions for commercial fleet management and vehicle operations, with a focus on digitizing maintenance workflows, dispatch operations, and service coordination. Its existing fleet-management platforms provide a foundation for extending operational support to autonomous vehicles and next-generation mobility services.
Technology & Product # SmartRide’s core products, D-note and IMMS, are SaaS-based fleet-management solutions supporting operational workflows such as driving records, dispatch, attendance, settlements, and vehicle maintenance.
Building on this foundation, SmartRide proposes an Autonomous Vehicle Service Hub Platform that standardizes service-center workflows across vehicle intake, diagnosis, repair, charging, waiting, and release. The solution combines structured operational data, a KPI dashboard, and standardized operating procedures (SOPs) to help service centers coordinate vehicle downtime and maintenance more efficiently.
Rather than replacing existing dealer management systems (DMS), the proposed platform would integrate selected operational data to support service-center operations and the emerging needs of autonomous vehicle fleets.
Market & Use Cases # The technology can support commercial fleet maintenance, automotive after-sales operations, service-center digitization, autonomous vehicle fleet support, and vehicle downtime management. Potential applications include coordinating maintenance and charging activities, tracking service-level performance, standardizing operational data, and improving the utilization of existing repair facilities and charging infrastructure.
Traction & References # SmartRide’s D-note and IMMS platforms are already operating commercially as paid fleet-management SaaS solutions. The company has also conducted an Emergency Roadside Service (ERS) pilot with the National Taxi Mutual-Aid Association in Seoul and SK SpeedMate, validating a three-party workflow covering service requests, assignment, handling, completion, and recurrence management.
SmartRide reports four registered patents, including technologies related to AI-based driver matching and cloud-based device registration. Its proposed Mercedes-Benz service-hub model remains at the proof-of-concept demonstration stage, while the underlying fleet-management software has reached commercial operation, corresponding to approximately TRL 7–8 for the core platform.
Collaboration Relevance # For Mercedes-Benz, SmartRide’s proposed platform could support more efficient after-sales operations and future autonomous vehicle fleet management by connecting maintenance, diagnosis, charging, and vehicle redeployment workflows. A lightweight proof of concept at a Mercedes-Benz Korea service center could evaluate whether standardized operational data and KPI monitoring improve repair turnaround times, service-level compliance, and infrastructure utilization without replacing existing DMS systems.

name: Somuna
summary: AI dual-battery control and idle-free refrigeration systems for refrigerated transport vehicles.
content:
Company Overview # Somuna develops battery management systems (BMS) and smart monitoring apps for logistics vehicles. Its main focus is eliminating engine idling in cold-chain logistics. It supplies battery-driven refrigeration units that keep food and medical cargo fresh even when the engine is off.
Technology & Product # Somuna offers three main technology and service modules:
AI Dual Battery Control Technology: Software and hardware that manages on-board secondary batteries to power ancillary vehicle systems independently of the main engine. AI Idle-Free Refrigeration System: A hybrid battery-driven cooling system that sustains refrigeration temperatures during cargo stops, eliminating fuel waste, noise, and tailpipe emissions. NODECAR Monitoring System: A real-time web platform and operations dashboard that tracks vehicle location, battery charge levels, and refrigeration compartment temperatures during transport. Market & Use Cases # Somuna serves cold-chain logistics, fresh-food delivery services, pharmaceutical transport operators, and commercial fleet managers. With Somuna’s battery system, fleet operators cut fuel costs, prevent cargo temperature swings, and meet urban anti-idling rules.
Traction & References # The company was selected by SK Innovation for the SV² Impact Partnering Season 2 green social venture program in 2020(Auto Daily). Somuna deployed its first retail commercial installation at SK Energy’s Incheon Naetruck House logistics depot in October 2020(CVinfo). The company completed its Pre-A investment round and was selected for the TIPS program in July 2025(DailySecu). Collaboration Relevance # Cold-chain logistics firms and e-grocery delivery fleets can run PoCs with Somuna. They can retrofit diesel delivery trucks with battery-powered cooling units to cut fuel use. Insurance companies can integrate Somuna’s real-time temperature tracking to verify cargo conditions and reduce fresh-food spoilage claims. EV chassis manufacturers can co-develop energy management modules with Somuna. These modules power refrigeration compressors directly from secondary battery banks.

name: SSenStone
summary: Cybersecurity company using one-time dynamic authentication for users, devices, IoT, PLC, and OT environments.
content:
Company Overview # SSenStone develops cutting-edge authentication technologies for user access, financial transactions, IoT, and OT/ICS environments. Its proprietary One-Time Authentication Code (OTAC) technology generates unique, dynamic codes in real time, enabling secure device and user validation even in offline or disconnected settings without an active network.
Technology & Product # OTAC is SSenStone’s core one-way dynamic authentication technology. It supports authentication between people, devices, and control systems.
Endpoint OTAC applies the technology to ICS and OT environments. It helps restrict PLC access to approved users and devices, and supports security work linked to NIS2, CRA, NERC CIP, and IEC 62443.
Other product areas include TAP OTAC for card-tap authentication, IoT Auth Platform OTAC, and HomeNet OTAC.
Market & Use Cases # SSenStone is relevant for industrial sites, OT operators, IoT device makers, financial institutions, access-control systems, and smart-home environments.
Use cases include PLC access control, device authentication, phishing-resistant authentication, industrial remote access, and dynamic credential replacement for connected devices.
Traction & References # SSenStone has more than 340 global patent applications, more than 200 registered global patents, and more than 380 global IP assets(SSenStone).
The company was ranked first in the Baby Unicorn program under Korea’s K-Unicorn project in 2020(ET News). Its UK subsidiary swIDch also placed first in the cybersecurity category at the 2020 Europas Awards(ET News) and won the 2020 CyberSecurity Breakthrough Award for Authentication Solution of the Year(Business Wire).
Global business runs through swIDch, and OTAC technology has been provided to more than 50 customers.
Collaboration Relevance # SSenStone can work with industrial operators, PLC makers, OT security teams, IoT device companies, banks, and access-control providers. A useful PoC can test dynamic authentication for PLC access, device registration, or remote industrial maintenance.
For Korea-Europe collaboration, SSenStone is relevant to OT security, NIS2, CRA, IEC 62443, and industrial cyber-resilience programs.

name: StepHow
summary: StepHow builds Wissly, an on-premise AI that connects enterprise documents, NAS, ERP, and groupware for source-backed search and work drafting.
content:
Company Overview # StepHow is a Korean company that builds AI products for enterprise knowledge and data. Its flagship product, Wissly, is an AI system that connects a company’s internal data and answers questions against it. The company also runs a US subsidiary in Delaware for overseas expansion.
StepHow was founded in 2024 and is based in Seoul. The team is small and focused on enterprise AI and large-scale document processing. Alongside Wissly, the company offers StepHow for AI-generated work manuals and knowledge management.
Technology & Product # Wissly connects documents, shared folders, NAS, ERP, and groupware into one AI workspace. Users ask questions in plain language, find the right information across large document sets, and check the original source passages next to each answer. They can then turn the result into summaries, comparison tables, and report drafts.
The core is a document processing pipeline built for scale. Wissly parses, chunks, embeds, and indexes files, including scanned PDFs and tables through OCR, so it can search by meaning rather than by filename. Search combines vector, keyword, and graph-based methods, and every answer is backed by cited sources. Access follows each organization’s data structure and permissions.
Security is central to the design. Wissly can run fully on-premise through an integrated appliance, Wissly-in-a-Box, for organizations that cannot send internal data to an external cloud. Two related products extend the platform: Ontology defines shared meanings and relationships across company data, and Wissly Code runs AI coding on an internal network using a local LLM.
Market & Use Cases # StepHow targets enterprises and public institutions that hold large volumes of scattered internal data and face strict security requirements. Typical early adopters are in construction, manufacturing, and the public sector, where contracts, drawings, specifications, schedules, and approval documents pile up across many systems.
Common use cases include cross-checking contracts and technical documents, answering internal process questions such as what forms a travel expense claim needs, analyzing spreadsheets, and drafting reports from verified sources. Because answers link back to the original documents, the tool fits teams that need to trust and audit the result, not just read a quick summary.
Traction & References # Wissly is in use and in active pilots with enterprise and public-sector customers. The City of Tallinn in Estonia ran a pilot for source-backed search across public administration documents, letting users verify answers against the original policies(Wissly). Hoban Construction is validating document AI across contracts, schedules, and technical reviews(Wissly), and Techcross is another customer(Wissly). Other customers include KAIST, Pulmuone, and Stemco(Wissly).
A product walkthrough covering document search, source checking, spreadsheet analysis, and report drafting is available as a demo video(YouTube).
Collaboration Relevance # StepHow fits enterprises, financial institutions, and public agencies that want AI over their own data but cannot move that data to a public cloud. A natural PoC connects a document, NAS, or ERP corpus and tests source-backed search and report drafting against real internal content, with deployment scoped to the customer’s security review.
For Korea-Europe collaboration, the City of Tallinn pilot shows early European public-sector traction. Wissly’s on-premise option is relevant for regulated and multilingual European organizations that need reliable process documentation and auditable document search. The Delaware subsidiary supports parallel expansion into the US market.

name: SweetnData
summary: SweetnData extends generative AI into physical spaces, delivering on-site, ultra-personalized AI content for brand, IP, exhibition, and retail spaces.
content:
Company Overview # SweetnData is an AI spatial-content company that extends generative AI into physical, offline spaces. Built on real-time space-and-AI connection technology, it turns what users imagine and feel into ultra-personalized content they can experience directly in a real space.
The company is more than a photo-booth or kiosk operator. It provides an AI content engine and on-site experience solutions for brand, IP, exhibition, tourism, retail, and entertainment spaces. Its core technologies are AI Consistency, AI Creativity, and AI Efficiency, which keep people, characters, and IP consistent while generating creative multimodal content and lightweighting the models so they run reliably on-site.
Technology & Product # SweetnData’s solution is an AI content platform that turns offline spaces into repeatable AI content experiences. Using its own multimodal AI foundation model and on-site operations technology, it instantly generates image, video, and merchandise content that fits each brand and IP concept across touchpoints such as AI photo booths, kiosks, magic mirrors, and media-art walls.
Content is generated from a user’s image, text, voice, or video input, then extended into on-site prints, QR downloads, social sharing, merchandise, and IP commerce. The flagship product, PhotoSweet, is an on-site solution running this engine. At its core, SweetnData is generative AI content infrastructure for offline spaces, not an AI photo booth.
Market & Use Cases # The main customers are companies and institutions that operate offline spaces in brand, IP, exhibition, tourism, retail, and entertainment. Typical uses include ultra-personalized experiences at pop-ups, exhibitions, and events, IP-based merchandise, and experience content in public and tourism spaces.
Traditional spatial content relies on custom production, which is costly, slow, and hard to reuse. On-site AI content that delivers multimodal generation, lightweight operation, and IP consistency together offers a clear alternative.
Traction & References # SweetnData has proven its technology through CES 2024 and 2025, selection for the CNT Tech-operated TIPS program (December 2024), the NVIDIA global enterprise collaboration program, and the Seoul Business Agency Pre-R&D program.
Application cases include IP collaboration on SM Entertainment’s Naevis, an AI photo-card kiosk based on Show Note musical content, AI safety-culture content for Hyundai E&C, IP content for LG Superstart Day, and a tourism photo booth for the Korea Racing Authority. The Hyundai E&C case drew more than 1,550 participants with 90.3% satisfaction. Collaborators include CJ ENM, Lotte Cinema, LG Science Park, and KDB, and the company was selected for the 2026 Gangnam-gu test-bed program.
Collaboration Relevance # SweetnData fits global brands, IP companies, and operators of retail, exhibition, and tourism spaces. CES participation and selection for the NVIDIA N-UP global collaboration program validated its potential in overseas markets, and it is preparing expansion centered on the US and Asia.

name: Syntherixs
summary: Syntherixs builds AI synthetic data for tables, text, and images so privacy-restricted data can still be used for analytics and AI.
content:
Company Overview # Syntherixs is a Korean company that builds synthetic data for AI. It recreates real datasets as artificial data that keeps the same statistical patterns and is designed so that no real individual can be identified. Teams can then analyze the data and train AI models even when the original records cannot be shared because of privacy rules.
The company covers three data types: tables, text, and images or video. It is based in Daegu, Korea.
Technology & Product # Synthera Tabular regenerates structured data, such as customer, claims, and transaction records, as synthetic tables that preserve the original statistics. Its SynthOptim engine also measures how useful the synthetic data is and how much privacy risk remains, then prepares the documents needed for a data-release review. The engine runs without a GPU.
Synthera Studio handles unstructured data. Privex rewrites text such as consultation records, complaints, and reviews, removing personal details while keeping the meaning and flow. SynFS replaces faces in images and video with synthetic faces while keeping the background, lighting, and expressions. Each delivery includes a review report that documents the safety, utility, and validity of the result.
Market & Use Cases # Syntherixs serves organizations that hold sensitive personal data but still need it for analytics and AI, including insurers, public agencies, and consumer and manufacturing companies.
Typical use cases include sharing data across borders or between entities without exposing individuals, training fraud and pricing models without personal data, and building generative-AI assistants on de-identified records. Public bodies can also open datasets to hackathons and startups using synthetic copies. In manufacturing, factory video with the people removed can be used to train safety and process models.
Traction & References # Synthera V1.0 received GS Grade 1 software quality certification from the Korea Testing & Research Institute in November 2025. Syntherixs has worked with public and enterprise organizations including the Daegu and Busan pseudonymized-data support centers, the National Information Society Agency, Korea Gas Corporation (KOGAS), Korea East-West Power, and Daegu Metropolitan City. It won a Grand Prize at the 6th Daegu Big Data Analysis Competition in 2024, part of several awards received between 2023 and 2025.
In April 2026 the company signed an MOU with the German Aerospace Center (DLR).
Collaboration Relevance # Syntherixs fits partners in insurance, consumer goods, manufacturing, mobility, and the public sector that hold restricted data they cannot fully use. Both Korea and Europe enforce strict data-protection regimes, so the company’s approach is designed to reduce privacy risk in line with European rules. This positions it as a candidate for compliance-focused evaluation under the GDPR and the EU AI Act.
Good PoC targets include co-validating synthetic tabular or unstructured data for quality and compliance, de-identifying claims imagery or customer text, and enabling cross-border data sharing within large groups. The company is actively looking for German and European partners.

name: Textway
summary: Textway builds on-premises enterprise AI that turns long-form documents into searchable, evidence-backed knowledge.
content:
Company Overview # Textway is a Korean deep-tech company that builds enterprise AI for long-form text. Its platform reads internal documents such as policies, claims files, reports, and articles, then returns answers with the exact source passage. The system runs on-premises or in a private cloud, so documents never leave the customer’s network.
The company was founded in 2022 and is based in Daegu. It works in production in Korean and English today, and other languages can be brought up on a customer’s own documents during a pilot.
Technology & Product # tB Server is the company’s enterprise product. It turns unstructured documents (PDF, HWP, DOCX, TXT) into a connected knowledge graph while keeping provenance, permissions, and relations intact. Every answer carries its source span, and the system keeps a full audit trail. Textway is also preparing tB Media for newsrooms and tB Hub, a cloud knowledge service.
The core technology is the PISA engine. Instead of matching keywords, it breaks text into predicate-centered units and builds a knowledge graph that it searches by structure. This lets it handle hard cases such as negation, exceptions, and “who did what to whom”, where keyword search and standard RAG often return the wrong answer. A deterministic function blocks any generated text that is not present in the source, which reduces hallucination.
Market & Use Cases # Textway targets organizations that depend on large volumes of complex text. Typical customers include public institutions, media companies, financial groups, and utilities. Common use cases are internal knowledge search, document question-and-answer, auto-tagging, and article production support for newsrooms.
Because it keeps data on-premises and records the source of every answer, Textway fits regulated sectors such as insurance, finance, and public services, where auditability and data control matter most.
Traction & References # tB Server launched as a commercial enterprise product after proof-of-concept deployments with more than 30 organizations, including public institutions, daily newspapers, and a maritime antenna manufacturer(AI Market Watch). License revenue in 2025 was KRW 394 million, with a PoC-to-paid conversion rate above 20%(AI Market Watch).
In 2025 the company was selected for the DeepTech TIPS program and the Youth Startup Academy deep-tech track(AI Market Watch). It raised a seed extension round from impact investor MYSC through the KAIST-MYSC Double Impact Fund, announced in November 2025(Venture Square), and earlier secured investment from accelerator Y&Archer(Hankyung).
For global expansion, the company completed a PoC and a patent filing in Singapore with local partner Tictag, and it is collaborating with San Jose State University in the United States(AI Market Watch).
Collaboration Relevance # Textway fits enterprises and public bodies that need trustworthy AI over sensitive, text-heavy archives. Its on-premises deployment and source-linked answers make it a strong PoC candidate for insurance, banking, utilities, and government, where general chatbots cannot meet audit and data-control rules. A typical pilot runs on one document class the customer chooses and is measured against the customer’s own benchmark.
For Korea-Europe collaboration, Textway can bring up German-language support on a partner’s own documents during a pilot, which opens insurance and other regulated-industry use cases in Europe. The engine is modular, so a second document class reuses the same system with only a new domain vocabulary.

name: TWELL
summary: TWELL turns the Korean botanical Aster yomena into standardized functional bioactive ingredients for cosmetics, nutraceuticals, food, and pet health.
content:
Company Overview # TWELL is a Korean bio company that turns a native plant, Aster yomena, into standardized functional ingredients. It controls the full chain from cultivation to finished ingredient, using extraction and fermentation to raise the plant’s value. Its ingredient platform is called YomenaX.
The company first brought its material to market in pet health with functional feed and supplements, which now generate steady cash flow. It is building on that base to expand into cosmetic, nutraceutical, and food ingredients. TWELL is an agricultural corporation based in Yeongcheon, with its own farm, R&D center, and production.
Technology & Product # TWELL grows Aster yomena and converts it into bioactive ingredients. The core process combines solvent extraction with microbial fermentation. Its lead extract ingredient, Implacell (YomenaX Extract), is standardized by HPLC against marker compounds such as rutin and dicaffeoylquinic acids.
Fermentation is the key step. Using its own strain, Lactobacillus fermentum MGE-3145, the company converts inactive compounds into more active ones. This aims to raise potency and bioavailability, so a smaller dose can reach the same effect. The process also generates new metabolites that create fresh IP. The YomenaX roadmap extends the same material into several product lines: an extract, a water-based cosmetic base, a fermented ingredient, an immune-support ingredient, and a liposomal delivery format. On the consumer side, TWELL sells functional pet feed, treats, prescription-diet feed, and supplements.
Market & Use Cases # TWELL works across four industries from one material: cosmetics, nutraceuticals, functional food, and animal feed. Today its revenue comes mainly from the pet health market, where functional feed and supplements have found steady repeat customers.
The larger opportunity is B2B ingredient supply. The company targets cosmetic ODMs and brands, nutraceutical ODMs, and global ingredient firms that want natural, standardized, clean-label actives. Typical uses include skincare ingredients, anti-obesity and atopy-related supplement actives, and immune-support ingredients. Over time, TWELL plans to move from selling products to supplying ingredients and then licensing its technology.
Traction & References # 2025 revenue was about USD 2.4 million, up from about USD 1.0 million in 2024, driven by functional pet products. The repurchase rate is around 32%, which shows strong customer loyalty. TWELL exports to three Southeast Asian markets — Thailand, Singapore, and Malaysia — with Thailand as the first export market in 2025.
On technology, the company received a KIST technology transfer at its start and developed the improved Aster yomena cultivar ‘Rubyche’ with the Jeonnam Agricultural Research and Extension Services. It has two SCI papers (anti-obesity published, atopy submitted), filed core patents in Korea with a PCT application in progress, and holds the proprietary strain L. fermentum MGE-3145. Preclinical atopy work in a DNCB mouse model showed about 50% improvement in key markers, and beagle toxicology testing was passed. TWELL was selected for TIPS and secured several national R&D programs, including an SME Ministry fermented-extract program and the KOSME Deep-Tech Academy. It runs a lean R&D model with partners such as Chonnam National University’s College of Veterinary Medicine, Daegu University, Korea National University of Transportation, and the Korea Testing & Research Institute.
Collaboration Relevance # TWELL fits partners who need natural, standardized functional ingredients with a secure, traceable supply. Good PoC candidates include cosmetic ODMs and brands testing a new plant-based active, nutraceutical companies evaluating an atopy or anti-obesity ingredient, and ingredient firms looking for a licensable strain and process.
Because TWELL controls cultivation, extraction, fermentation, and quality control in-house, it can offer traceable supply and standardized lots. This suits open-innovation and co-development projects where a partner wants to co-develop an approved ingredient or license IP. For Korea-Europe collaboration, the company’s clean-label botanical actives and fermentation IP are relevant for cosmetics and nutraceutical ingredient buyers, and its export experience in Asia shows it can serve overseas B2B customers.
